summary_1line: Sampati recounts waiting a century for Rama’s cause and miraculously regains his wings as the sage’s prophecy comes true.

image_candidates.scene_text: Before the gathered monkeys on the Vindhya mountain, the aged vulture Sampati suddenly sprouts tawny new wings from his scarred body.
The wingless Sampati crawls from a dark cave and slowly climbs the rugged Vindhya mountain to await the destined arrival of Rama’s allies.
